We also evaluated system output by eliciting human judgments via Amazon's Mechanical Turk. Native German speakers (self reported) were asked to rate simplifications on three dimensions: Grammaticality (is the output grammatical and fluent?), Meaning Adequacy (to what extent is the meaning expressed in the original sentence preserved in the output, with no additional information added?), and Simplicity (is the output a simpler version of the input?).
